Ventilazione sala pompe

The process and system for providing safe airflow in the pump room to prevent accumulation of explosive vapors and maintain a safe working environment.

What is Ventilazione sala pompe?

In this glossary, Ventilazione sala pompe refers to: The process and system for providing safe airflow in the pump room to prevent accumulation of explosive vapors and maintain a safe working environment.

How is Ventilazione sala pompe used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Prima di entrare nella sala pompe, verificare che la ventilazione sia attiva da almeno trenta minuti e comunicare lo stato all’ufficiale di guardia."

Definition

The process and system for providing safe airflow in the pump room to prevent accumulation of explosive vapors and maintain a safe working environment.

Operational example

Before entering the pump room, verify that ventilation has been running for at least thirty minutes and report status to the officer on watch.

Localized term

Ventilazione sala pompe

Localized example
